# Load libraries

```{r}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, tidyverse, readxl, glmmTMB, DHARMa, here,nimble, nimbleExtra)

```

#

```{r}
dates <- as.Date(unique(survival$date))

dates <- c(as.POSIXct("2025-06-27"), dates)

dates <- as.Date(dates)

do_2 <- do %>%
  group_by(as.Date(datetime), bag) %>%
  mutate(daily_min = min(DO_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
         date = as.Date(datetime))

do_2$interval <- cut(do_2$date, breaks = dates, labels = as.character(dates[-1]))

do_3 <- do_2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(interval)) %>%
  group_by(bag, interval) %>%
  summarise(avg_DO_min = mean(daily_min))

survival$bag <- substr(survival$bag_num, 1, 2)

do_3$interval<- as.Date(do_3$interval)
survival$bag <- as.factor(survival$bag)
do_3$bag <- as.factor(do_3$bag)

survival_2 <- left_join(survival, do_3, join_by("date" == "interval", "bag" == "bag"))

# way O2 data is structured can't parse out diff between top and bottom, just between dense and sparse





# need to get average DO minimum for each date interval and bag 
# append Avg DO minimum to survival, join by bag and date

```


```{r}

# need to filter so that low tide ones stay when immersed, high tides stay when immersed
do_current_2 <- do_current %>%
  filter((tide== "H" & up_Immersed == "Y")| (tide== "L" & low_Immersed == "Y")) %>%
  group_by(as.Date(datetime), bag) %>%
  mutate(daily_min = min(DO_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
         date = as.Date(datetime))

do_current_2$interval <- cut(do_current_2$date, breaks = dates, labels = as.character(dates[-1]))

do_current_3 <- do_current_2%>%
  filter(!is.na(interval)) %>%
  group_by(bag, interval) %>%
  summarise(avg_DO_min = mean(daily_min))

survival$bag <- substr(survival$bag_num, 1, 2)

do_current_3$interval<- as.Date(do_current_3$interval)
survival$bag <- as.factor(survival$bag)
do_current_3$bag <- as.factor(do_current_3$bag)

survival_2 <- left_join(survival, do_current_3, join_by("date" == "interval", "bag" == "bag"))
```
